title: 门店人员变化与销售变化诊断
context: 人力＋销售联合分析：管理层要求以同一企业口径核对业务数据。
requirements: 2025年门店×月，月末在岗人数使用历史区间，月度净销售使用实际交易；计算环比人力及销售变化率，上月为0或缺失返回NULL；标记人数增加而销售下降。
commonError: 人力变动与销售变化相关并不证明因果。
mysqlSql: WITH m AS (SELECT month_key,MAX(day) last_day FROM calendar_days WHERE month_key>='2024-12' GROUP BY month_key), h AS (SELECT s.store_id,m.month_key,COUNT(e.employee_id) headcount FROM stores s CROSS JOIN m LEFT JOIN employment_history e ON e.store_id=s.store_id AND e.start_date<=m.last_day AND (e.end_date IS NULL OR e.end_date>m.last_day) GROUP BY s.store_id,m.month_key), a AS (SELECT store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(net_cents) net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date>='2024-12-01' GROUP BY store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), z AS (SELECT h.*,COALESCE(a.net,0) net FROM h LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=h.store_id AND a.m=h.month_key), p AS (SELECT *,LAG(headcount) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key) prev_h,LAG(net) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key) prev_net FROM z) SELECT store_id,month_key,headcount,net net_cents,ROUND(100.0*(headcount-prev_h)/NULLIF(prev_h,0),2) headcount_change_pct,ROUND(100.0*(net-prev_net)/NULLIF(prev_net,0),2) sales_change_pct,CASE WHEN headcount>prev_h AND net<prev_net THEN 1 ELSE 0 END review_flag FROM p WHERE month_key>='2025-01' ORDER BY store_id,month_key
